name: Deleting Compatible Minimum Sections
statement: In a supplied rank-$r$ maximum class, let $M[b_i]=\partial_{B_i}M$ be designated minimum sections whose patterns agree on every overlap. Deleting all words matching any designated pattern has a rank-$r$ maximum parent using at most $\sum_i\max(r+1-|B_i|,0)$ auxiliaries. Blocks may be processed in any order; unprocessed minimum properties and any disjoint old mark are preserved.
proof: Compatibility gives a common pattern and nonemptiness of the residual class. Inductively choose a maximum predecessor that retains all protected minimum properties. The one-section deletion lift then lowers the target marked section by one rank while keeping every compatible protected minimum at both heights. Repeating empties one designated section in $r+1-|B_i|$ steps and leaves the remaining hypotheses intact.
